title: @c15t/iab: IAB TCF 2.4 and GPP Addon
description: IAB TCF 2.4 and Global Privacy Platform (GPP) addon for c15t with TC String and GPP string generation, GVL support, TCF and GPP APIs, and programmatic advertising consent workflows.
features: IAB TCF 2.4 support for programmatic advertising consent
IAB GPP 1.1 API (`__gpp`) with US state, MSPA US National and TCF EU sections through `@c15t/iab/gpp`
Purpose, special purpose, feature, special feature, and vendor controls
Headless APIs for custom IAB consent experiences
prerequisites: Use [Inth](https://inth.com) for a hosted IAB TCF-certified CMP setup with a managed CMP ID, or register your own CMP with IAB Europe and configure your own CMP ID
manualInstallation: For React UI components, use the @c15t/react IAB subpath and stylesheet:
usage: Configure c15t with the IAB consent model for jurisdictions that require TCF workflows
Use the React IAB components for a prebuilt TCF banner and preference center
Use headless APIs when you need a custom IAB consent experience
Use `createGPP` from `@c15t/iab/gpp` to signal US state opt-outs and GPC to ad tech; see the [IAB GPP docs](https://c15t.com/docs/frameworks/javascript/gpp)
For full implementation details, see the [IAB TCF 2.4 docs](https://c15t.com/docs/frameworks/react/iab)

customSections.Related Packages:
- [@c15t/react](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@c15t/react): React IAB consent banner, dialog, and hooks through @c15t/react/iab
- [@c15t/backend](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@c15t/backend): Backend configuration for IAB TCF, GVL, CMP registration, and custom vendors
- [c15t](https://www.npmjs.com/package/c15t): Core consent engine
